title: Minecraft Spider
blurb: Short, dry and directional. The spider hiss is enough to make any Minecraft player stop mining immediately. You get one burst, then silence, then possibly a very fast set of legs coming round the corner. Cave spiders in abandoned mineshafts made it considerably worse by adding poison to the equation, so an entire generation learned to associate this tiny noise with backing slowly towards a wall. It works beautifully as a jump-cut sting in edits for the same reason: there is no time to prepare for it.
